goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: Approve a prerequisite-only framework package, not the combined Fumadocs install. T096 establishes that Fumadocs MDX needs Next >=15.3 and React >=19.2; the current lock is Next 15.2.2/React 19.0.0 and marks Next deprecated for a security vulnerability. Patched Next 15.5.24 and React 19.2.8 satisfy that floor, while fumadocs-mdx 15.3.1 also requires fumadocs-core ^16.7.0 and fumadocs-ui 15.8.5 requires Tailwind, absent from the manifests. Adding Fumadocs UI/Tailwind exceeds a narrow upgrade. Document the custom renderer as fallback and defer Fumadocs integration.

worker_package.objective: Upgrade only the existing framework compatibility floor to Next.js 15.5.24, React 19.2.8, React DOM 19.2.8, @types/react 19.2.18, and @types/react-dom 19.2.5; preserve the current custom docs renderer, ingestion pipeline, static fallback/search, raw routes, and truthful content. Record that renderer as the current local fallback and defer Fumadocs/Tailwind integration to a separately approved package. Do not add Fumadocs, Tailwind, peer overrides, or unrelated dependency/tooling changes.
verify: pnpm exec vitest run tests/docs-ingestion.test.ts tests/docs-routes.test.ts
stop_if: Any write is needed outside allowed_files, including Fumadocs/Tailwind manifests, source, ingestion code, generated documentation/content, reports, plans, or external systems.
The lockfile requires unrelated direct dependency or tooling changes beyond the specified framework and React type packages.
Peer overrides, hidden incompatible installs, or deprecated framework versions are required.
Current docs rendering, ingestion validation, static search, raw routes, or truthful content regress after the upgrade.
A verification command fails twice for the same in-scope cause.
Browser verification collides with an unrelated server or requires stopping or modifying an unrelated process.

evidence: T096 receipt: no files changed; official Fumadocs MDX compatibility requires Next ^15.3.0 and React ^19.2.0.
apps/web/package.json pins Next 15.2.2, React 19.0.0, and React DOM 19.0.0.
pnpm-lock.yaml records Next 15.2.2 as deprecated for a security vulnerability.

fumadocs-mdx@15.3.1 additionally requires fumadocs-core ^16.7.0; fumadocs-mdx@14.3.2 supports fumadocs-core 15.x but still requires the newer framework floor.
